description: Look up what AlterLab has measured about a domain; a layer or field with too few samples is omitted, never estimated. Public: success_rate, typical_tier, typical cost, median_latency_ms, antibot_vendor and common_failures over many customers' unauthenticated scrapes, with field_samples. platform: vendor_family, challenge_class and recommended_mode (auto or js) across all traffic, gated on request volume only, no customer data. own (signed-in sessions only): your organisation's last 30 days on the host: by_tier and by_mode success, cheapest_successful_tier, median cost and latency, common_failures, last_success_at. known is true when any layer has data; next_action suggests the measured cheapest mode and tier. Use before scraping a site to budget credits and skip failed probes; it is informational, AlterLab still chooses tier, proxy and pace. An unknown domain returns known: false and the free estimate path (alterlab_estimate_cost). Free, and a call never scrapes the site.

domain.description: Hostname only, e.g. example.com (no scheme, path or query)
